# IQ Mermaid

> IQ Mermaid is a free, no-sign-up mermaid diagram editor. It has two synced views — a visual canvas (double-click to add a block, drag to connect) and a mermaid code editor — so you can build a diagram either way and get valid mermaid syntax out. Supports flowchart, sequence, class, ER, state, gantt, git graph, and pie diagrams. Export to SVG, PNG, .mmd, or a fenced Markdown block. Nothing is stored server-side: diagrams live in the browser's local storage.

## Product

- [Editor](https://iq-mermaid.com/app) — the live editor: visual canvas and mermaid code side by side.
- [Home](https://iq-mermaid.com) — overview, feature list, FAQ.

## How it works

- No account, no paywall, every feature (including export) is free.
- Visual tab edits flowcharts directly; the mermaid code tab renders any diagram type mermaid supports.
- Paste existing mermaid code into the code tab — a flowchart is parsed back onto the canvas with nodes, shapes, colors, and subgraphs intact; other diagram types render in preview but stay code-only.
- Works offline once loaded — rendering happens client-side, storage is local to the browser.
- Available in 34 languages; the editor itself and blog slugs stay in English across locales.
